tour.home.scan: Scan to measure reclaimable space before choosing a run.
tour.home.dryRun: Dry-run shows what the engine would remove without deleting your files.
tour.home.safety: Open the safety detail to see which personal paths windowsweep refuses.
tour.sections.filter: Filter the section list by what needs your attention.
tour.sections.table: Expand a section to read what it covers and whether it needs you or an administrator.
tour.sections.selection: Review the selection bar before rehearsing the chosen sections.
tour.choose.filter: Filter the listed items before making a choice.
tour.choose.table: Select an item only after reading its path and size.
tour.choose.consequence: Read the removal method and consequence before continuing.
tour.run.prepared: Check the prepared sections and mode before starting.
tour.run.start: After checking the dry-run, use Start to run the prepared action.
tour.run.log: The log shows each section's result when the run finishes.
tour.history.filter: Use Show to narrow the run list to those you need.
tour.history.table: Open a row to inspect that run's report.
tour.history.total: The total counts space freed by real runs in the current view.
tour.report.summary: Read the heading to distinguish a dry-run estimate from space reclaimed.
tour.report.sections: Inspect the section results to see where the figure came from.
tour.report.export: Export this report if you need a copy outside the app.
tour.account.signIn: Sign in to connect eligible run summaries across your machines.
tour.account.stored: Read the stored-data list to see what belongs to your account.
tour.account.delete: The deletion section names what goes and what stays before you confirm anything.
tour.settings.tabs: Choose a tab to inspect its settings.
tour.settings.thresholds: Review the thresholds before changing what a scan includes.
tour.settings.privacy: Open Privacy to see what the app sends and what it refuses to send.
tour.settings.version: Open About to check the installed app and engine versions.
tour.plans.allowance: Check how many real runs remain this month; scans and dry-runs do not count.
tour.plans.options: Compare Pro and Team before choosing a billing period.
tour.plans.referrals: Open your referrals to see confirmed friends, points and earned Pro months.
tour.walkthrough.scan: Scan first to measure the sections windowsweep can inspect.
tour.walkthrough.sections: Open Sections to inspect what each section covers.
tour.walkthrough.choose: Choose an item only after checking its path and removal method.
tour.walkthrough.protected: Open the protected-path list to see which personal paths windowsweep refuses to remove.
tour.walkthrough.rehearse: Use a dry-run to see the expected result before any deletion.
tour.walkthrough.result: Read the completed dry-run to check what the engine would have done.
tour.walkthrough.report: Open a run's report from History to see its recorded result.
